svg.title: AI Component Builder — Generative UI · Cursor SDK
svg.desc: Feature 3 of 5: AI Component Builder — Generative UI · Cursor SDK. Status: built at a Cursor workshop in Rajkot. Describe a component in plain English; get working React back. A chat panel streams generated React components from the Cursor SDK into a live preview with syntax-highlighted code. Fig. 5, from prompt to preview: 1. Prompt — chat panel; 2. Generate — Cursor SDK, streamed over SSE; 3. Preview — sandboxed iframe + code view. Stack: Next.js 14, TypeScript, Cursor SDK, SSE, Tailwind. Link: github.com/harshbhx/cursor-rajkot-workshop.
